# Press or drop

## Rule

One press trigger. A bad touch, a pass we can reach, a keeper who has it at their feet with no outlet. If the trigger is not there, drop as a block.

Pressing with no trigger is how rec teams get played through.

## Cue

Can we win it in two seconds. If not, drop.

## Seen in us

_None yet._
